candidates.title: Horizontal negative-bar values occupy the category-label column
candidates.source_content_vs_engine: Engine geometry: three short category names, three values [3, 2.5, -0.5], and one series. No unusual density. Changing orientation is an author workaround, not a horizontal-renderer correction.

repro.then: Call render_deck_thumbnails with density=100 and max_slides=1.
repro.result: Both controls return success=true and deterministic_ready=true despite the 79–80% text_overlap info finding and a visible North / −0.5 collision.

geometry.conclusion: The labels occupy the same category slot; their right edges are 5.33px apart and baselines 4.88px apart. Reported overlap is 79%.

pointers: svggen/bar_horizontal.go:206 — left reserve for negative values
root.explanation: horizontalLayout adds valueReserve to plot.X for negative bars, but drawHorizontalCategoryNames anchors the category relative to that new plot.X. The most-negative bar ends at plot.X; its right-aligned value then occupies the same left band as the right-aligned category. The reserve moves both labels together rather than separating them.

acceptance: The mixed-sign [3, 2.5, -0.5] chart with East / South / North has a clear category/value gap and no text_overlap on p-style and modern-yellow. Inspect actual PNGs.
Cover all-negative data, shallow negatives, mixed signs, long category names, grouped and stacked horizontal bars, and several label formats.
Preserve the zero baseline, sign/value fidelity, positive label clearance and role readability floors. Do not suppress labels or require vertical orientation.

existing_beads.overlap: The previous issue covers the VERTICAL lower plot edge. Its closure adds vertical negative headroom. The current horizontal category gutter has a distinct root; file an atomic follow-up linked to 5na8e.

candidates.title: Deck-level source disappears from quantitative native tables
candidates.source_content_vs_engine: Engine default attribution: meta.source contains a complete illustrative-case attribution. The table contains currency values, and the same source is visible on neighboring charts.

repro.result: The numeric table has no Source line on all ten reviewed PNGs and in OOXML; generation does not report a missing source.
repro.control_result: Adding slides[4].source writes Source: Illustrative management accounts, FY26 into slide5.xml. The control PNG shows the attribution clearly.

root.explanation: Parent will confirm the classifier/attribution root. Explicit per-slide source works; the failure is limited to default source propagation or classification. Merge with the parent quantitative option-matrix source candidate if they share this root.

acceptance: DeckSpec meta.source supplies visible attribution to quantitative native tables on all ten production templates, including p-style.
Explicit per-slide sources override the fallback; avoid duplicate attribution and preserve legible content and source bands.
Cover currency, rate and period tables and numeric text-scale option matrices. Exercise validate and render, and inspect actual PNGs.

existing_beads.overlap: Parent owns the monetary table-highlight option case. Deduplicate after confirming the root.

excluded.reason: Supported counts do not guarantee capacity on every template. Validation already predicts INPUT.TEXT_BELOW_READABLE_MIN plus BODY_TOO_LONG: 340pt needed vs 318pt available. Removing the duplicate band preserves the decision in an owned action. Closed k3eb3 covers fitting; this fixture does not establish a new bug.

Validation predicts the 10.32pt option-name refusal. Closed bzh34 explicitly leaves modern table-plus-takeaway overflow as a known, predicted limitation. Removing redundant details and takeaway works.

The final modern KPI label is 10.08pt, meeting the documented 10pt caption floor in tokens/typography.go:18. A generic generation warning calls it body text with a 12pt floor. This is diagnostic inconsistency; no visual floor violation is claimed.
The default promises distinct values, not exact source precision. Explicit %.4f%% labels render correctly on all ten templates. This is an author formatting repair, not a missing capability.
